unresolved_candidate.description: The LED-array board clearly requires a physical spacing decision, but no authoritative center-to-center spacing value is visible in the supplied history.

The AXP2101 thermal-pad stencil change was proposed during diagnosis, but the history later attributes sample damage to component moisture handling; audit should determine whether a windowpane aperture became an actual design requirement.
The enclosure has clear implementation requirements but was discussed as a possible separate project; human review may confirm whether it belongs in this contract's retained inventory.

The freelancer reports adding a VRTC output even though the client requested VRTC remain unconnected while exposing VBACKUP and PWROK; event extraction should preserve the authority conflict without treating the freelancer implementation as a client modification.

The USB protection fix was claimed complete, but the client immediately questioned whether the symbol truly separated VBUS and GND; later evidence does not visibly verify the corrected protected configuration.
